kind: selection rule for the sparsity sensitivity arm

problem_being_solved.measured: the registered sensitivity checkpoint separates from the primary by about 1.12x on the unpaired mean and 1.07x on the unpaired median, against the 3.07x the README table implies
problem_being_solved.why_this_matters_beyond_wasted_compute: At that separation the arm contrasts two nearly equally sparse models, so it would almost certainly agree with the primary. A sensitivity analysis that is bound to agree READS as robustness evidence while establishing nothing. That is an inferential harm, not merely a compute cost.
problem_being_solved.the_readme_cannot_be_used_instead: OD-004 falsified the README table's direction, so its nominal L0 values may not stand in for measurement when choosing an arm

step_1_acquisition.path: the identical byte-verification and content-addressing route used at P-0: fetched by the cloud VM, checked against the origin-published authority, content-addressed into models/sha256/<aa>/<full>, create-only under If-None-Match

step_2_measurement.protocol: identical to the primary and sensitivity measurements already performed
identical_in: the OpenThoughts3 val split, never train
the same slice size of 200 rows taken as a deterministic prefix
the same code, the same masking, batch_size 1, bf16
step_2_measurement.why_identical_matters: the selection compares candidates against the primary, so any protocol difference would be confounded with the quantity being selected on

step_3_selection_rule.why_a_paired_median_ratio: it is the OD-004 primary statistic applied to selection: paired by layer, and a median rather than a mean so the layer 26 and 27 tail cannot dominate the choice
step_3_selection_rule.why_two_sided: separation in either direction gives the arm leverage; a candidate that is much sparser is as informative as one that is much denser
step_3_selection_rule.chosen: among qualifying candidates, the one with the greatest separation from 1.0

step_4_if_none_qualify.action: DELETE the sparsity sensitivity arm entirely
step_4_if_none_qualify.reported_as: a conclusive limitation, namely that the published checkpoint family does not, on measurement, provide effective sparsity leverage
step_4_if_none_qualify.why_not: it is a measured property of the released artifacts; reporting it is more informative than running an arm that cannot discriminate

why_this_is_not_outcome_dependent_select.statement: The selection criterion is L0, an instrument property measured before any accuracy measurement exists and entirely unrelated to the estimand.
why_this_is_not_outcome_dependent_select.consequence: the arm cannot be chosen for producing a preferred result, because at selection time no result of any kind has been observed

claim_ceiling: Selecting or dropping this arm is an instrument decision. It is not evidence about J-space, about distillation, or about reasoning.
